title: VTC Badges — Mine — Show — payload
description: Show a badge the signer had hidden: back on their wall, back in the badge's holder list and its count, back in their kudos total. The reverse of vtc/badges/mine/hide. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

badgeId.description: A badge the signer holds: at least one accepted award of it. Shown as a whole, every award at once.

badge.description: The badge as the signer now holds it: `hidden` false; `pinned` as it was, which after a hide is false.
